name: NY-20
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Paul Tonko running in a D+8 district
Markets price Tonko at ~97% to win

model.rationale: Tonko is a well-funded incumbent in a district that leans Democratic by eight points, while challenger Ralph Ambrosio has raised almost nothing and drawn no outside support. Prediction markets price Tonko near 97%, consistent with the fundamentals-based margin of roughly twenty points.
model.watch: Any late surge in challenger fundraising or outside spending, or a polling surprise, would be the main signal that this race is tightening.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Paul Tonko, a Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a Capital Region district that backed Democrats by about eight points in recent elections. He has raised nearly a million dollars and holds over $400,000 in cash, while Republican Ralph Ambrosio has raised under $30,000 with no outside spending on either side. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Tonko roughly a 97% chance of winning.

The fundamentals point the same direction: district lean, a favorable national environment for the incumbent's party, incumbency advantage, and a large money edge all stack in Tonko's favor. Absent unexpected developments, this race is expected to remain safely Democratic.
